content:
More about boards and filters in Jira Cloud.
This page is for company-managed spaces
To check whether your space is team-managed or company-managed, select More actions (•••) next to the space name in either the header or the sidebar. At the bottom of the menu that opens, your space details will be shown.
Configuring a board lets you edit the mapping of workflow statuses to columns of a board, as well as edit the columns, swimlanes, and quick filters of a board, and customize the card colors and displayed fields in the work item.
Before you begin
To configure the board and any of its settings, you must be either:
- a space administrator for the location of the board
- a board administrator for the board itself
See Permissions overview for more information.
Access board settings
- From your board, select more () then Configure board.
- On the Board settings screen, select the desired tab (Columns, Swimlanes, etc).
If you need to see both the work and the rest of your scrum or kanban board, you can choose to open the Jira work item as a right sidebar. To do it, go to a board and choose > Open work items in sidebar.
Rename a board
- From your board, select more () > Configure board.
- On the board settings screen, select the 'pencil' icon(which will appear when you hover) to edit the name of your board. Press the Enter key when finished.
Delete a board
- Select the search field (or press / ) and choose View all boards.
- Find your board and select more (), then Delete.
This will delete the board, but not the board's work items. This is because work items belong to the space, and boards are simply another way to view work.
Change a board's administrators
A board's administrator is the only person who can change the configuration of a board along with Jira administrator users. By default, the administrator of a board includes the person who created it. If you're a board administrator or a Jira administrator, you can change the administrators of a board. See Permissions overview for more information.
- Go to your board, then select more (), then Configure board.
- On the board settings screen, select any of the names in the Administrators field (a 'pencil' iconwill appear when you hover over them).
- Enter the names of the desired users or groups. If you start typing the name, a list of users and groups will be suggested. Press the Enter key when finished.
The suggested user list will not display if you don't have the Browse users and groups global permission. However, you can still enter the user names and group names manually. See Permissions overview for more information.
